Open this link on a device with ZUULI

This link is meant for ZUULI, the free2z wallet, which also sets up your e2e2z identity. It opened in your browser because ZUULI isn't installed here, or the link was opened in the browser instead of the app.

What to do

  • ZUULI is on another device: open the link there.
  • ZUULI is on this device: go back and tap the link again. On iPhone you can also press and hold the link and choose Open in “ZUULI”.
  • You were in the middle of something in another free2z app: go back to that app and start again. This page can't finish it.

Install ZUULI

iPhone: invitation only, through TestFlight. Ask for access below.

Android: invitation only, through Google Play internal testing. Ask for access below.

ZUULI is only available to invited testers right now: TestFlight on iPhone, Google Play internal testing on Android.

Ask for access: help@free2z.com

Anything after the “#” in this link stays on your device. This page doesn't read it or send it anywhere, and when JavaScript is on it also removes it from the address bar.
